stages.label: Continue
stages.sub: Pick up later where you left

stage_mapping: Codex owns the LearningStage enum. Today the app has StudyLearningPhase EXPLORE/TRY/REVIEW/COMPLETE; proposed mapping: START+DISCOVER→(new), EXPLAIN+EXPLORE→EXPLORE, PRACTICE→TRY, REFLECT→REVIEW, CONTINUE→COMPLETE/resume. The UI only reads `stage` + `nextAction`; it never infers stage from the transcript.

hint_ladder.label: Remember
hint_ladder.sub: What did you do in class?

hint_ladder.label: Worked step
hint_ladder.sub: Halo does one step, you do the rest

hint_ladder.label: Full solution
hint_ladder.sub: Every step with reasons — opt-in, with confirm

hint_note: Brief order ≠ current TutorStage order (ASK, HINT, EXPLAIN, ANALOGY, CHECK_ATTEMPT, PARTIAL_SOLUTION, SOLUTION). UI shows rungs in the brief's order; CHECK_ATTEMPT is the 'Check my thinking' action, not a rung. The solution rung is never locked by points or time (C07) — it is opt-in and confirmed, as today.

components.name: Halo Ring (kids / standard)
components.purpose: Presence bound to the REAL runtime state (idle, listening, capturing_voice, thinking, speaking, waiting, stopped, error, offline, success).

components.name: Intent indicator (Guide trace)
components.purpose: Marks the ONE recommended action: one lap on first appearance, then breath pulse. Moves, never multiplies.

components.name: Voice dock
components.purpose: Persistent bottom dock: big mic (72dp kids / 56dp adult) ⇄ Stop, captions line, Type alternative, Help. Mic ripple only while mic is open.

components.name: Caption strip
components.purpose: Live captions of what halo says and what it heard. Tap a word to hear it again (kids read-along).

components.name: Focus card
components.purpose: The single live learning task: concept/question, optional illustration, 1-3 contextual actions. Never scrolls the task away.

components.name: Journey path
components.purpose: 7 stages as an open-ring path; kids see icons only (Now / Next), adults see a breadcrumb.

components.name: Hint ladder
components.purpose: 5 rungs; climbing is the learner's choice; shows where you are, never a score.

components.name: Source chip
components.purpose: Where an explanation comes from: note, file page, photo, general knowledge. Tap → source view (S43).

components.name: Where-it-runs chip
components.purpose: On this phone / Needs cloud OK / In the cloud / Offline / Provider unavailable. Required on voice, vision and generation screens (C09).

components.name: Cloud consent sheet
components.purpose: Explains what leaves the phone, who must agree (grown-up PIN for kids), local alternative, Not now. Never traced.
components.asset: new · cloud_handoff plays only AFTER consent

components.name: Draft review
components.purpose: AI draft visually separate (dashed accent border, 'Draft' tag) from the child's work; Keep / Change / Discard; no auto-accept.

components.name: Effort progress
components.purpose: Counts reasoning steps tried and ideas understood — never minutes, streaks or rank. Optional bloom on genuine progress.

components.name: Provider-state message
components.purpose: Calm card for unsupported provider / offline / OCR unsure / cancelled, always with a usable alternative.

components.name: Big choice tile
components.purpose: Kids picture tile ≥ 56dp, icon + 1-2 words, max 3 per screen.

components.name: Extraction overlay
components.purpose: Outlined exercise boxes on the photo with confidence: solid = sure, dashed + Apricot dot = please check.

components.name: Grown-up gate
components.purpose: PIN-protected parent options, adult-mode exit, sharing, cloud consent.

gaps.note: The app ships values / values-lv / values-ru; there is no values-pl. Polish copy, speech and TTS availability must be verified per installed model.
The 7-stage journey is new; today only StudyLearningPhase (4) exists. Codex defines the enum; UI binds to it.

Brief order ≠ current TutorStage order (ASK, HINT, EXPLAIN, ANALOGY, CHECK_ATTEMPT, PARTIAL_SOLUTION, SOLUTION). UI shows rungs in the brief's order; CHECK_ATTEMPT is the 'Check my thinking' action, not a rung. The solution rung is never locked by points or time (C07) — it is opt-in and confirmed, as today.
Only cloud image providers exist (WorkspaceImageService / AiImageProvider). Drawing tile is hidden unless a provider is configured AND a grown-up consented; otherwise 'Draw it yourself in Canvas'.
halo_learn_frame needs a page-quad signal from the analyser; without it, show static corners + 'Hold still', never fake a lock.
Grown-up gated share is designed; the existing share path for Kids was not verified in source.
12 s kids / 20 s adult are design defaults, to be tuned in testing; the trigger is 'no input after halo finished speaking', never a timer alone.
Comps follow BrandBook v2.1 + DevKit v1.2 tokens; no device screenshots of the current Kids/Study screens were provided, so current-state notes come from source only.

rules: One recommended action at a time (Intent moves, never multiplies).
Motion is never the only signal: every cue has text, speech and a TalkBack label.
Ring shows the REAL runtime state; no listening animation while the mic is closed.
Stop cancels TTS, generation, capture and pending FX in the same frame; no late success after cancel.
Intent never on cloud opt-in, purchase, new permission or destructive action.
Bloom only after a CHECKED independent success; never for time spent.
Kids touch targets ≥ 56dp, mic 72dp; adults ≥ 48dp; max 3 choices per kids screen.
Reduced motion: static SVG of the same state, no movement.
